chinese: 他们试图在市长 上火车前赶上他

chinese: 最后的祷告

chinese: 巴比伦最后的酒神节

english: Brown eyes...ah me, ah me!

chinese: 居鲁士与他的副官冈比西斯 整合军力

chinese: 【卡里加利博士的小屋】

english: Act I.
chinese: 第一场

english: "There are spirits... They are all around us...
chinese: 到处都是幽灵，它们就在我们周围

english: They have driven me from hearth and home, from wife and child..."
chinese: 它们驱使我远离健康和家庭 远离妻子和孩子

english: "That is my fiancee..."
chinese: 那是我未婚妻

english: "What she and I have lived through is stranger still than what you have lived through..."
chinese: 我与她的经历比你的经历离奇多了

english: "I will tell you about it."
chinese: 我给你讲讲这段经历...

english: "The little town where I was born..."
chinese: 我出生的那个小镇...

english: "A fair."
chinese: 年度游园集会

english: "Alan, my friend."
chinese: 我的朋友，阿兰...

english: SPECIAL EDITION Fair in Holstenwall ! For the first time!
chinese: 【特号】 霍斯腾沃尔游园集会 各种从未出现过的展示

english: "Come, Franzis, let's go to the fair!"
chinese: 走吧, 弗朗西斯，去集会玩玩吧！

english: "Don't go inside...
chinese: 您别进去啦！

english: The town clerk is in a vile temper today!"
chinese: 市务秘书今天情绪不佳！

english: Dr. Caligari.
chinese: 卡里加利博士

english: "Wait!"
chinese: 等等！

english: "I wish to apply for a permit to present my spectacle at the fair..."
chinese: 我想申请能在游园会上展出我的展示品

english: "What kind of spectacle?"
chinese: 什么样的展示品？

english: "A somnambulist."
chinese: 一个梦游者

english: "Step rrrrright up!
chinese: 进来看啦！

english: Presenting here for the first time.
chinese: 给你们看从来没见到过的！

english: Cesare the somnambulist!"
chinese: 梦游者，凯撒！

english: End of Act I.
chinese: 第一场结束

english: Act II.
chinese: 第二场

english: That night the first in a series of mysterious crimes took place.
chinese: 那一晚起，开始了一系列神秘犯罪事件

english: "Murder!
chinese: 谋杀！

english: The town clerk has been killed." "Stabbed in the side with a strange pointed instrument."
chinese: 一件非常尖锐的利器刺入身体一侧 造成了市务秘书的死亡

english: "Step rrrrright in!
chinese: 过来看啦！

english: Presenting here for the first time..."
chinese: 给你们看从来没见到过的！ 梦游者，凯撒！

english: The miraculous Cesare... twenty-three years old... he has slept for twenty-three years... Continuously... Day and night!
chinese: 神奇的凯撒，活了23年，睡了23年，日夜不断

english: Cesare will awaken from his death-like trance. "Step right in!"
chinese: 凯撒将会在你们的眼前，从僵尸复活！

english: "Cesare... Can you hear me?"
chinese: 凯撒，听到我说话吗？

english: Cesare...
chinese: 凯撒，我在召唤你！

english: I am calling you... I...
chinese: 我是卡里加利博，你的主人

english: Dr. Caligari... your master... "Awaken for a moment from your dark night..."
chinese: 黑夜中醒来片刻吧...

english: "Ladies and gentlemen!" Cesare the somnambulist will answer all your questions...
chinese: 女士们先生们，梦游者凯撒会回答你们所有问题

english: Cesare know every secret...
chinese: 凯撒知道所有秘密，凯撒既了解过去，又能预见未来

english: Cesare knows the past and sees the future...
chinese: 您们亲自来验证吧！

english: Judge for yourselves. Don't hold back... "Ask away!"
chinese: 请走上台来，亲自提问吧！

english: "How long will I live?"
chinese: 我能活多久？

english: "Till the break of dawn."
chinese: 活到明天黎明破晓

english: MURDER in Holstenwall 1000 Marks Reward.
chinese: 霍斯腾沃尔谋杀案 悬赏1000马克

english: The way home.
chinese: 回家路上...

english: "Alan, we both love her."
chinese: 阿兰，我们俩都爱她

english: "We'll leave the choice up to her..." But whomever she chooses, "we shall remain friends."
chinese: 让她自己来做选择吧 无论她选了谁，我们仍是好朋友

english: Night.
End of Act II.
chinese: 第二场结束

chinese: 第三场

english: "Mr. Franzis, Mr. Franzis... Mr. Alan is dead... murdered!"
chinese: 弗朗西斯先生，阿兰先生死了！

english: "The somnambulist's prophecy...? !"
chinese: 梦游者的预言！

english: "I won't rest until I get to the bottom of these dreadful deeds."
chinese: 没查清楚这发生在我身边的恐怖之事 我绝不会善罢甘休

english: "I will obtain police authorization to examine the somnambulist."
chinese: 我要从警察那获得许可，检查那个梦游者

english: "Murderer!
chinese: 杀人啦！

english: Murderer!"
chinese: 谋杀！

english: "Wake him up."
chinese: 叫醒他！

english: EXTRA EDITION
chinese: 号外！

chinese: 霍斯腾沃尔的谋杀之谜解开了！

english: Two-time murderer caught in third attempt!
chinese: 前两次谋杀的凶手在第三次行凶时候被捕！

english: End of Act III.
chinese: 第三场结束

chinese: 第四场

english: Worried because her father has been away so long...
chinese: 对长期不归的父亲的担忧

english: "I had nothing to do with the two murders... so help me God..."
chinese: 我与两宗谋杀案毫无关系 上帝啊，帮帮我

english: "The old woman... It's true... I tried to kill her..."
chinese: 刚才那老女人，没错，我是想杀她 想用类似的凶器刺她身体的一侧

english: by stabbing her in the side with a similar knife... "to throw suspicion on the mysterious murderer."
chinese: 我是想要把线索转移到那个神秘凶案的凶手身上

english: "Is my father... Dr. Olsen here?"
chinese: 我爸爸不在这儿吗，那个医务顾问奥尔森？

english: After the funeral.
chinese: 葬礼之后...

english: "Cesare...!"
chinese: 凯撒!

english: "It couldn't have been Cesare..."
chinese: 不可能是凯撒做的呀！

english: He was asleep at the time... "I've watched him for hours..."
chinese: 他那时正在睡觉， 我观察了他好几小时

english: End of Act IV.
chinese: 第四场结束

chinese: 第五场

english: "Is the prisoner secure in his cell?"
chinese: 囚犯... 绝对... 还被关在牢房里面吗？

english: "I must see him!"
chinese: 我要看看他

english: INSANE ASYLUM
chinese: [精神病院]

english: "Do you have a patient by the name of Caligari?"
chinese: 你有一个叫"卡里加利博士"的病人吗？

english: "The director returned earlier today... Perhaps you should speak to him personally..."
chinese: 院长先生今天已经回来了 或许你可以亲自去问问他

english: "He... himself...
chinese: 那个人...

english: and none other... is Caligari..."
chinese: 他就是卡里加利

english: While the director, now placed under observation, is sleeping in his villa...
chinese: 当人们盯着院长在他的别墅里睡觉时

english: "He's asleep."
chinese: 他睡了

english: SOMNAMBULISM A Collection from Uppsala University. Published in 1726.
chinese: 《梦游者》 乌普萨拉大学文献集 1726年出版

english: "His specialty."
chinese: 他的专业

english: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari. In the year of 1703, a mystic by the name of Caligari toured the fairs of numerous villages in northern Italy, accompanied by a somnambulist named Cesare...
chinese: 《卡里加利博士的小屋》 1703年，一位名叫卡里加利博士的人 带着一个叫凯撒的梦游者 在意大利北部的一些城镇的集会上巡回展出

english: For month he sowed panic amongst village folks through a series of foul murders committed under almost identical circumstances.
chinese: 一连几个月，他藉由一系列手法几乎完全一样的谋杀 引起了一个又一个的镇的恐慌

english: He had entirely subjugated to his mill a somnambulist named Cesare, whom he did compel to carry out his nefarious schemes.
chinese: 梦游者完全屈从于他的意志，还被迫执行他的离奇的计划

english: A puppet, the exact likeness of Cesare, and which took his place in a cabinet, allowed him to divert any suspicion that might fall on the somnambulist.
chinese: 藉由他放在箱子里酷似凯撒的假人 他躲过了一切对梦游者的怀疑

english: My Diary
chinese: 我的日记

english: 12 March. Finally... finally!
chinese: 3月12日 终于...

english: A somnambulist has been brought to the asylum for admission...
chinese: 终于！ 有一个梦游者今天来精神病院登记入住了！

english: Afternoon. My desire...
chinese: 中午...

english: I shall be able to satisfy my life's unwavering wish! Now I shall unravel the psychiatric secrets of this Caligari!
chinese: 我一生的夙愿终将要实现 现在我可以揭示卡里加利精神病学的秘密了

english: Now I shall discover if it is true that a somnambulist can be compelled to perform acts that in a waking state he would never commit and would be repugnant to him.
chinese: 现在，我要去证实： 一位梦游者是否会去做一些 在他们清醒状态下不会去做的事情...

english: Whether it is true that a sleepwalker can be led to commit... even murder!
chinese: 就是说，一位梦游者是否会被教唆而去谋杀？

english: An obsession.
chinese: 强迫症

english: "I must know everything... I must penetrate his secrets... I must become Caligari!"
chinese: 我一定要知道每件事 我要洞悉他的所有秘密 我要成为卡里加利...

english: You must become Caligari.
chinese: 你一定要成为卡里加利！

english: End of Act V.
chinese: 第五场结束

english: Act VI.
chinese: 第六场

english: "We found the sleepwalker out in the fields..."
chinese: 我们在外面野地里发现了梦游者

english: "Mr. Director... Unmask yourself...
chinese: 院长先生，扔掉你的面具吧！

english: You are Dr. Caligari!"
chinese: 您就是卡里加利博士！

english: "... and from that day on, the madman never again left his cell."
chinese: 从那天起，那个疯子就再也没有离开过他的牢房

english: "Look! There's Cesare... Never allow him to tell your fortune ...or you're dead..."
chinese: 快看，那个就是凯撒 绝对不要让他给你算命，否则你必死无疑

english: "Jane, I love you... won't you be my wife at last?"
chinese: 简，我爱你！ 你还是不愿意嫁给我吗？

english: "We queens are not free to answer the call of our heart..."
chinese: 像我这样的女王... 是无法随心所欲的

english: "You all think that I'm insane!
chinese: 你们都以为我疯了吗！

english: It isn't true...
chinese: 你们错了！

english: It's the director who's insane!"
chinese: 院长才是疯子！

english: "He is Caligari...
chinese: 他是卡里加利！

english: Caligari...
chinese: 卡里加利...

english: Caligari!"
chinese: 卡里加利！

english: "At last I understand his delusion." He thinks I am that mystic Caligari! "Now I know exactly how to cure him..."
chinese: 终于，我明白了他的妄想症 他以为我就是那个神秘的卡里加利 现在我也知道如何治疗他了

english: English translation by Robert Gray (Kinograph)
chinese: -=THE LAST FANTASY=- 字幕调校: yourtear@TLF

english: Once there was a poor Salvation Army sister at death's door.
chinese: 曾有一个垂死的可怜的小传道者

english: She was stricken with galloping consumption, and she had only held out for the space of a year.
chinese: 她患上了致命型的肺痨 捱不过一年

english: When there was no hope left she had gone home to her mother.
chinese: 当所有的希望幻灭的时候 她回到了母亲的身边

english: Waiting at the foot of her bed was another Salvation Army sister who had once worked alongside the sick girl.
chinese: 在床脚下，站着一位传道者 她和这位患病的女人一起工作过

english: "Don't fret over those poor souls now, Sister Edit."
chinese: "艾迪特修女，现在别想那些不幸 的人了。

english: "You have done enough for them."
chinese: 你为他们做得够多了"

english: "Send for David Holm!"
chinese: "派人去叫大卫・霍姆过来！"

english: "Please don't!
chinese: "别叫他！

english: My daughter was yours as long as she had a spark of life."
chinese: 因为只要她身上仍有 一颗生命的火花你就让她呆在 你的身边。

english: "Let me have her to myself now that she is dying."
chinese: 现在她即将死去 就让她呆在我的身边吧！"

english: "Slster Maria, why don't you do as I ask?
chinese: "玛丽亚修女，你为什么不照我 说的做呢？

english: Send for David Holm!"
chinese: 派人去叫大卫・霍姆！"

english: "l shall go fetch him at once."
chinese: "我马上请他过来"

english: "You can't be serious, asking David Holm to attend a death bed?"
chinese: "不可以那样做！ 你绝对不能 让大卫・霍姆来见垂死之人"

english: "l haven't been able to find him, but Gustavsson is looking too." "He will bring him here if that is at all possible."
chinese: "不，我没能找到他，但是 格斯塔夫森先生到外面去找他了 我确信，他会尽可能地把他带来的"

english: "Poor Mrs Holm Poor Mrs Holm"
chinese: "我非常抱歉，霍姆夫人！ 我非常抱歉，霍姆夫人！"

english: "l'll take her back home."
chinese: "是的，我要再次把她带回家。

english: "lt wouldn't do for her husband to see her should he come."
chinese: 如果 她丈夫来了，千万不能发现她在这儿"

chinese: 那天晚间发生的所有的事情 并不是每晚都会有的。

english: It was New Year's Eve.
chinese: 那晚是除夕

english: "Well, we will certainly know when it's time to toast the New Year!"
chinese: "在这个地方，我们一定能 知道何时该举杯庆祝元旦！"

english: "lt's a spooky place to await midnight, here among the dead."
chinese: "但是，这可能是一个令人 毛骨耸然的地方，元旦那天，你 看到这个地方是处于死人堆里的"

english: "You gentlemen are not afraid of ghosts, I hope?"
chinese: "你们不怕鬼，是吗，先生们？"

english: "Then I'd like to tell you a story while we wait for the midnight hour."
chinese: "那我想给你们讲一个元旦的故事 当时，我们在等着12点的钟声敲响"

english: "l once had a pal called Georges, who was generally a jolly fellow."

chinese: 让我的一切都随风而逝！

english: "Do what you like to me, my Lord, only spare the three of them!"
chinese: 你想对我做什么就做什么吧 哦，生与死的主人 但愿这三个人能得到宽恕！"

english: "David, I see that I no longer need to grieve for you!"
chinese: "大卫！ 现在我能看出 我无需再为你悲伤了！"

english: "Sister Edit is dead, and I have been at her side."
chinese: "艾迪特修女死了，我去看过她 我答应她，我要好好地待你和孩子们"

english: "You're lying!
chinese: 玛丽亚修女告诉我说你拒绝她的给予！"

english: "No one believes I want to reform."
chinese: 我想弃恶从善 我想做个好人，但是没人愿意相信我 那不是一个哭泣的理由吗？"

english: "lt's hard to believe, David."
chinese: "你明白，大卫，这是难以置信的 但当你哭时，我相信你了 现在，我相信你"

english: "l can't help crying too."
chinese: 直到我的 眼泪将我内心所有的悲痛驱散 我才能够幸福"

english: "Lord, please let my soul come to maturity before it ls reaped."
chinese: "上帝，让我的灵魂在 它被收获之前成熟起来！"

english: THE END
chinese: 配乐： KTL Stephen O'Malley [SunnO)))乐队吉他手] and Peter Rehberg [叫Pita更多人知道]

chinese: 位于科隆的Piethopraxis录音室内完成制作

chinese: 影片《尼伯龍根》在當時沒有留存下一個完整的通用的德國版本

english: DIE NIBELUNGEN has never been presented in any complete German version, whether by way of any extant release print, or anything struck from an original camera negative.
chinese: 我們沒有獲得任何那時候完整版本的拷貝或者負片

english: This photochemical restoration is based on incomplete camera negatives.
chinese: 這次是根據不完整的負片進行修復的

english: Missing sections were supplemented by various extant prints of the period along with archival copies.
chinese: 缺失部分則根據不同版本的拷貝進行了移取

english: Colouration follows the conventional method of then-contemporary prints, and is based upon original tinting technique:
chinese: 本片的色彩則是根據當時的著色工藝 將染料塗在黑白拷貝上的

english: the production of a BW print, with subsequent staining performed in a dye-bath.
chinese: 中間的德語字幕則是根據現存拷貝...

english: The German intertitles were taken from extant prints and flash-titles restored digitally from the negatives.
chinese: 以及負片上的記錄樣本進行了數碼修復

english: Missing titles that have been reconstructed are designated by the Murnau-Stiftung logo.
chinese: 在那些被重建的缺失字幕畫面左下角 添加了「茂瑙基金會」的標記： FWMS

english: For this HD mastering, the image has been corrected in places, and heavy damage to the film has been retouched.
chinese: 在製作高清版本的時候，增強了一些地方的圖像穩定 並修復了一些嚴重的畫面壞損

chinese: 蒂婭·馮·哈布根據電影《尼伯龍根》 而創作的二十四格畫冊《尼伯龍根》... 由慕尼黑的「三面具出版社」出版 [蒂婭·馮·哈布正是弗裏茨·朗的妻子]

english: KRIEMHILD'S REVENGE
chinese: 【克裏米爾特的復仇】

english: The First Canto:
chinese: 第一節

english: How Kriemhild Mourned Siegfried, and How König Etzel (King Attila) Courted Her
chinese: 【克裏米爾特祭奠齊格弗裏德】

english: Through Rüdiger von Bechlarn.
chinese: 【匈奴國王埃策爾派遣使者呂狄格 前來追求克裏米爾特】

english: King Gunther, Margrave Rüdiger von Bechlarn asks for an audience!
chinese: 龔特爾國王，來自貝赫拉恩的呂狄格侯爵求見！

english: I come as ambassador to King Attila. He who is called the Lord of the Earth -
chinese: 我此行是代表「大地之王」匈奴王而來

english: He who seeks the hand of your sister Kriemhild in marriage.
chinese: 他希望能夠執手令妹克裏米爾特

english: I am afraid King Attila knows not whom he woos.
chinese: 我恐怕匈奴王自己並不知是在向誰求婚

english: In the name of Siegfried, who was murdered and whose murderer lives!
chinese: 以被害人齊格弗裏德之名起誓，害人者仍舊逍遙法外！

english: Keep in mind how Siegfried died!
chinese: 大家要記得齊格弗裏德是什麼死的！

english: Lord Attila sends me, O Queen, to ask for your hand on his behalf!
chinese: 匈奴之王派我前來向女王殿下求婚！

english: You seem to know quite well, Rüdiger, that I have been exposed to grievous wrongs in the house of my clan!
chinese: 呂狄格，看來你們是相當清楚... ...我在自己的家族裏所遭受到的欺辱

english: Brother!
chinese: 哥哥！

english: Where is your brother Siegfried?
chinese: 你的那位兄弟齊格弗裏德呢？

english: Deliver unto me the murderer of my husband, O King!
chinese: 把謀害我丈夫的兇手交我處置，國王！

english: He has remained loyal to me; so shall I remain loyal to him.
chinese: 他是忠於我，我不能背叛他

english: This, Kriemhild, is my final word!
chinese: 克裏米爾特，這是我最後給你的答覆！

english: Lady Kriemhild, Margrave Rüdiger, wishes to speak with you after evensong!
chinese: 克裏米爾特夫人！ 呂狄格侯爵想要在晚禱之後跟您們談談！

english: Now, Gerenot, is the time to keep close watch over Burgundy!
chinese: 吉倫特，現在是時候讓整個勃艮第加強警戒了！ [吉倫特是克裏米爾特的一個弟弟]

english: Speak to me of Lord Attila, Rüdiger!
chinese: 呂狄格，跟我講講匈奴王這人吧！

english: You court a dead woman, Rüdiger!
chinese: 呂狄格，你們現在所要追求的是一個已經死去的女人！

english: He who murdered my husband flaunts the greensparkling sword that he stole from the dead man.
chinese: 而謀害她丈夫的兇手現在還在 炫耀著那把從亡者身上掠來的綠光寶劍

english: If ever you were done wrong at Attila's court, my lady, - Lord Attila would know how to avenge you!
chinese: 誰要是冒犯到您，匈奴王是一定會幫您報仇的

english: Lord Margrave, swear this unto me in your and in King Attila's names!
chinese: 侯爵大人，請以您以及匈奴王的名義向我起誓！

english: Not on the cross, Lord Margrave, - on the sharp edge of your sword!
chinese: 不用對著十字架，而是要對著你的劍刃發誓！

english: My lady!
chinese: 夫人！

english: Lord Hagen has stolen the Treasure!
chinese: 哈根大人把寶藏都偷走啦！

english: You have my word, Lord Margrave Rüdiger!
chinese: 我跟您一言為定，呂狄格侯爵！

english: Hagen Tronje, where is the Treasure?
chinese: 哈根·特洛涅，財寶到哪裏去了？

english: Thus spake loyal Hagen:
chinese: 那個忠誠的哈根說道： 在某個地方，夫人！

english: Somewhere, my lady, where no-one might use the gold to forge arms against the kings of Burgundy!
chinese: 那樣就沒有人能用這些財寶對抗勃艮第王國了！

english: Thus ends the First Canto.
chinese: 第1節結束

english: The Second Canto:
chinese: 第2節:

english: How Kriemhild Fled Her Homeland, and How She Was Received by Lord Attila.
chinese: 【克裏米爾特背井離鄉，並被匈奴王接納】

english: You have drunk Siegfried's blood, O Earth!
chinese: 大地啊，你已飲過齊格弗裏德的血

english: One day I shall drench you with Hagen Tronje's blood!
chinese: 總有一天，我會用哈根·特洛涅的血讓你得到灌溉！

english: I shall return!
chinese: 我會回來的！

english: Rest assured, I shall return!
chinese: 你放心吧，我會回來的！

english: My daughter, shall you not proffer your hand in farewell to your brother Gunther?
chinese: 我的女兒啊，難道你不去跟你胞兄龔特爾道別嗎？

english: No, mother.
chinese: 不了，母親

english: You are heading far away, Lady Kriemhild. Don't you want to make peace with your family first?
chinese: 克裏米爾特夫人，您即將遠行 難道不想跟您的家族修好嗎？

english: No, my priest.
chinese: 不了，神父

english: Don't you even once want to hail your people, my lady?
chinese: 難道你一點都不想向您的人民致意嗎，女主人？

english: No, Rüdiger.
chinese: 不了，呂狄格

english: As Kriemhild approached, springtime blossomed in the land of the Huns.
chinese: 當克裏米爾特來到的時候，正值匈奴國春暖花開

english: That sack full of gold is mine!
chinese: 那一整兜子的金子是我的！

english: The queen is coming!
chinese: 王后來啦！

english: Meet her, brother!
chinese: 去迎接她，兄弟！

english: Royal jewellery!
chinese: 取皇室珍寶來！

english: My lady, King Attila's brother, Blaodel, gives thee welcome!
chinese: 夫人，匈奴王的弟弟布勞德爾前來迎接您！

english: Choose for yourself a kingdom from my lands, Rüdiger, in gratitude for this woman!
chinese: 呂狄格，從我的帝國疆土中選一塊領土來賜予這位女士！

english: Ask King Attila, Margrave Rüdiger, whether he is prepared to make your oath his own!
chinese: 呂狄格侯爵，幫我問一下匈奴王： 他是否已經準備兌現你們諾言！

english: Upon my oath, O Queen:
chinese: 我以自己人頭發誓：

english: any man who insults you or does you wrong shall die a hundredfold death!
chinese: 我會讓任何冒犯女王您的人... ...都死上一百遍！

english: Thus ends the Second Canto.
chinese: 第2節結束

english: The Third Canto:
chinese: 第3節

english: How King Attila Besieged Rome and How Kriemhild Summoned Her Brothers.
chinese: 【匈奴王休戰羅馬，克裏米爾特向兄弟們發出邀請】

english: Lord Attila swore he wanted to turn Rome's churches into stables for our horses!
chinese: 匈奴王發過誓，要把羅馬的教堂變成屬於我們的馬廄呢

english: Why does Lord Attila no longer uphold his oath?
chinese: 為什麼埃策爾國王不再堅持當初的誓約呢？

english: We traipsed headlong into war!
chinese: 我們現在已經陷入戰亂僵局！ ！

english: Why don't we ride further onward?
chinese: 為什麼我們不再一鼓作氣繼續騎行？

english: Why is Lord Attila's horse tethered to his tent?
chinese: 為什麼匈奴王的戰馬被拴在帳篷外沒再跑過？

english: A great horseman was King Attila!
chinese: 匈奴王曾是偉大的騎手啊！

english: A mighty mare for him was the world!
chinese: 以前他的眼裏就只有一匹強壯的母馬！

english: Lord Attila whipped the world - his mare!
chinese: 埃策爾國王總會甩鞭抽打他的世界以及他的母馬！

english: What does Lord Attila do now?
chinese: 而埃策爾國王現在又在幹什麼呢？

english: He sleeps!
chinese: 他在睡覺！

english: Lord Attila, Attila sleeps!
chinese: 匈奴王他睡著了！

english: This white woman has stolen Attila from underneath our noses!
chinese: 那個白種女人從我們手裏搶走了埃策爾！

english: With her tresses does she bind up the horseman, The great horseman, Lord Attila!
chinese: 用她的長髮纏住了偉大騎手匈奴王的手！

english: My lord -!
chinese: 陛下...

english: Kriemhild...
chinese: 克裏米爾特...

english: Kriemhild has borne you a son!
chinese: ！ 克裏米爾特她為您生了一個兒子！

english: O Earth... sacred Earth...
chinese: 大地... 聖潔的大地... ！

english: One wish, O Queen!
chinese: 許個願吧，皇后！

english: One wish that I might fulfill for you!
chinese: 我會實現你的願望！

english: If you would honour me and make me happy, Lord Attila, then summon my brothers as guests to your court!
chinese: 要是你當真想要讓我高興！ 匈奴王，你就邀請我的兄弟們來你的宮殿做客吧！

english: To Worms, Blaodel, to request as guests to our court the royal brothers of my wife!
chinese: 布勞德爾，你去沃爾姆斯去邀請 我妻子的皇室弟兄來我皇宮做客

english: Thus ends the Third Canto.
chinese: 第3節結束

english: The Fourth Canto:
chinese: 第4節

english: How Kriemhild Received Her Brothers.
chinese: 【克裏米爾特如何迎接她兄弟】

english: For more than one moon's time your brothers stayed as guests of Rüdiger in the house of Bechlarn.
chinese: 作為呂狄格的客人，你的兄弟們 要在貝赫拉恩逗留將近一個月

english: The minstrels sing a new song of the love between your brother Giselher and Rüdiger's only child, the beautiful Dietlind!
chinese: 吟遊詩人正在唱誦著一首關於 你弟弟吉賽爾赫與呂狄格的美麗的獨生女迪特琳德之間的愛情歌曲

english: And so I bind in faith -
chinese: 現在我衷心地將貝赫拉恩以及勃艮第兩國結為同盟

english: Bechlarn and Burgundy: one heart, one life, one death!
chinese: 大家一條心，共生死！

english: To honour your brothers,
chinese: 為了向你的兄弟表示心意

english: Lord Attila has sent the noblest of his knights - Dietrich von Bern - to greet them.
chinese: 匈奴王已派出他最高貴的騎士迪特裏希前去恭祝他們

english: Once more, Nibelungen, before Lord Attila comes to greet you:
chinese: 再說一次，尼伯龍根，在匈奴王埃策爾來祝賀你們之前 別忘記是誰讓你們能在埃策爾國王面前擁有舉足輕重的地位！

english: How could we forget, my lord, that we come to visit our sister Kriemhild?
chinese: 大人，我們怎麼會忘記是來拜訪我們的姐姐克裏米爾特的呢？

english: Whoever wants to win my gratitude shall bear my sorrow in mind!
chinese: 想要讓我感恩，必先承擔我的傷痛！

english: It was the day of the summer solstice, and the Nibelungen arrived at Attila's court.
chinese: 在夏至的前一天，尼伯龍根人抵達了匈奴王的宮殿

english: King Attila, I now exhort you to your oath!
chinese: 埃策爾國王，我現在只想提醒一下你別忘記誓約！

english: Siegfried's murderer is in your hands!
chinese: 殺害齊格弗裏德的兇手現在正在你的手上！

english: Think upon my sorrow!
chinese: 請體諒我遭受的傷痛！

english: Will you never forget Lord Siegfried, my lady?
chinese: 夫人啊，難道你就永遠忘不了齊格弗裏德嗎？

english: Hagen Tronje shall fight me for his life!
chinese: 哈根·特洛涅願意為我誓死而戰！

english: You mustn't fight with the murderer, Attila!
chinese: 你決不能跟兇手並肩而戰，我的王！

english: You must have the murderer killed!
chinese: 你應該把他殺掉！

english: Have our guest killed?
chinese: 殺掉我們的客人？

english: You swore to me, Attila!
chinese: 你向我發過誓的，匈奴王！

english: On the life of your child: Make good upon your oath!
chinese: 以你孩子的生命發過誓，絕不反悔！

english: I hail from a desert land, O Queen.
chinese: 我是沙漠之子，皇后！

english: If only one thing is sacred, it is a guest!
chinese: 對我來說，遠來的客人是神聖而不可欺的！

english: So long as Hagen Tronje regards the peace of my house, he shall be left in peace!
chinese: 只要哈根·特洛涅對我顯示足夠的尊重 那我就不會去動他！

english: She spoke:
chinese: 她發話了：

english: Whoever brings me the head of Tronje, I shall fill his shield with gold!
chinese: 誰要是帶給我特洛涅的人頭 我就給他花不完的金子！

english: But I beseech you: do no harm to the sons of my mother!
chinese: 不過我請你們不要傷害我母后的那幾個兒子！

english: Play on, bard!
chinese: 接著往下唱！

english: Thus ends the Fourth Canto.
chinese: 第4節結束

english: The Fifth Canto:
chinese: 第5節

english: How the Huns Celebrated the Summer Solstice with the Nibelungen.
chinese: 【匈奴人跟尼伯龍根人一起慶祝夏至】

english: Is it the fashion at Worms upon the Rhine to sit at table armed from head to foot?
chinese: 難道在萊茵流域，你們的沃爾姆斯城的習慣是 全副武裝赴宴的嗎？

english: Lord Hagen Tronje knows why he never lays aside his sword!
chinese: 哈根·特洛涅心裏很清楚他自己為什麼劍不離手！

english: Methinks that at such a feast the heir to all Attila's crowns mustn't be absent!
chinese: 我認為，這樣的場合肯定不能讓匈奴王的子嗣缺席的！

english: Methinks the boy will not live long.
chinese: 我覺得這孩子的命不會長...

english: Scarcely shall we as guests attend any court of his!
chinese: ...估計我們以後沒什麼機會參加他舉辦的什麼宴會了！

english: Treason!
chinese: 叛亂啦！

english: The child!
chinese: 孩子！

english: The work of your guest, Lord Attila!
chinese: 匈奴王，這就是你客人幹出來的好事！

english: Now, Nibelungen, you are fair game!
chinese: 現在起，我跟尼伯龍根人奉陪到底！

english: I demand safe conduct from this hall for myself and my men!
chinese: 我希望能你們能確保我跟我的部下離開這個大廳！

english: Thus ends the Fifth Canto.
chinese: 第5節結束

english: The Sixth Canto:
chinese: 第6節

english: The Nibelungen's Distress.
chinese: 【尼伯龍根的危難】

english: Alert Lady Kriemhild of what it is you see!
chinese: 去告訴克裏米爾特你所看到的！

english: Open the gate!
chinese: 把門打開！

english: No Hun survives any longer in Attila's hall!
chinese: 皇宮裏面已經沒有活著的匈奴人了！

english: Avenge thy dead, Huns!
chinese: 匈奴人，為他們復仇！

english: O Queen, it is impossible!
chinese: 皇后，實在難以打敗他們！

english: Avenge thy dead, Huns, and the royal child!
chinese: 匈奴人，一定要為死去人以及你們的王子報仇雪恨啊！

english: Sister!
chinese: 姐姐！

english: Consider your mother!
chinese: 想想我們的母親吧！

english: Hand over Siegfried's murderer - and you shall be free!
chinese: 交出殺人兇手，你們就能自由！

english: The fight is too uneven!
chinese: 他們實在是寡不敵眾！

english: Not one of the Nibelungen will gaze upon this next dawn.
chinese: 等到明天日出時，尼伯龍根人都將喪命！

english: In Giselher does my own child die!
chinese: 我的親女兒要跟吉賽爾赫死在一起了！

english: Stay out of it, Rüdiger!
chinese: 別捲進這場戰亂，呂狄格！

english: Blood shall follow blood!
chinese: 血債就該血來償！

english: Get me Rüdiger!
chinese: 把呂狄格叫過來！

english: The time is nigh, Lord Rüdiger!
chinese: 這個時刻已經到來，呂狄格侯爵！

english: Make good upon your oath!
chinese: 兌現你過去的誓言吧！

english: Lord Margrave Rüdiger, I demand from you Siegfried's murderer!
chinese: 呂狄格侯爵，我想讓你把殺害齊格弗裏德的兇手交給我！

english: You do not send me against Hagen Tronje,
chinese: 不要讓我去跟哈根·特洛涅作對！

english: - you send me against your brothers, my lady, who defend him with their very lives!
chinese: 皇后，你是在命令我跟你的哥哥開戰！ 因為他會想盡辦法保護哈根的！

english: You've sworn an oath, Rüdiger!
chinese: 呂狄格，你們是發過誓的！

english: You've sworn it upon the sharp edge of your sword!
chinese: 你是對著劍刃發了重誓的！

english: I engaged my only child to Giselher!
chinese: 我已經把自己的親女兒許配給吉賽爾赫！

english: Blood shall follow blood, Lord Rüdiger!
chinese: 血債就該血來償，呂狄格侯爵！

english: My lord! Do not force me to kill my only child!
chinese: 我的國王，不要逼我去傷害我的女兒！

english: Thus ends the Sixth Canto.
chinese: 第6節結束

english: The Seventh Canto:
chinese: 第7節

english: The Nibelungen's End.
chinese: 【尼伯龍根曲終】

english: Lord Rüdiger stands before the gate!
chinese: 呂狄格爵士站在大門面前！

english: He will bring us peace!
chinese: 他會幫我們調解戰亂的！

english: What do you bring us, father?
chinese: 岳父大人，你給我們帶來了什麼？

english: Death!
chinese: 死亡！

english: My lord, do not allow they who love one another to kill one another!
chinese: 國王啊，請不要讓相愛的雙方相互殘殺！

english: Tell them:
chinese: 去告訴他們：

english: They must deliver unto me the murderer of my child - and they are free!
chinese: 他們必須要交出殺害我兒子的兇手，那樣我就放過他們！

english: You know not the German soul, Lord Attila!
chinese: 看來你還是不瞭解德國人的想法，埃策爾國王！

english: The oath I made to Kriemhild is older than the oath between myself and you!
chinese: 克裏米爾特和我立下的誓言，比你跟我女兒的婚約還要早！

english: Don't force me to break my oath!
chinese: 別逼我違背誓言！ 拿起你們的劍吧！

english: Do you wish me to lose my honour? !
chinese: 你們想讓我成為一個無信用的小人嗎？

english: - Defend yourself, Hagen Tronje!
chinese: 來跟我打吧，哈根·特洛涅！

english: O sister, what you have wrought!
chinese: 姐姐，這就是你的傑作！

english: Deliver Hagen unto me - and you are free!
chinese: 把哈根交出來，就放你們走！

english: Exalt in your revenge, Kriemhild!
chinese: 克裏米爾特，對你的復仇行動滿意吧？ ！

english: Your younger brother is dead!
chinese: 你的弟弟死了！

english: Rüdiger and his men are dead!
chinese: 呂狄格跟他的部下也死了！

english: But Hagen Tronje lives on, who slew your Siegfried!
chinese: 但是那個殺了你齊格弗裏德的哈根·特洛涅還活著！

english: Hurl fire into the hall!
chinese: 放火燒他們！

english: My lord!
chinese: 國王！

english: The Queen bids the hall be bombarded with fire arrows!
chinese: 皇后讓人用火箭燒大堂！

english: The palace is burning!
chinese: 宮殿燒起來了！

english: Lady Kriemhild is right, she is more than right!
chinese: 克裏米爾特做得對！ 她做得對極了！

english: I myself will stand at her side as the fire flushes the murderer Hagen from his hole!
chinese: 要是能用火逼出那兇手哈根，我絕對會支持她的做法！

english: You have my thanks, Kriemhild!
chinese: 我真是要謝謝你，克裏米爾特！

english: Although we were never united in love, we will, in the end, yet be united in hate!
chinese: 雖然我們從未愛在一起 但我們最終卻會恨在一起！

english: Never, King Attila, was my heart so filled with love as now!
chinese: 不，埃策爾，我的內心對你一如既往的充滿了愛意！

english: I don't want King Gunther of Burgundy to die a smoky death!
chinese: 我不想讓勃艮第的國王龔特爾被煙熏死！

english: I shall offer Lady Kriemhild my head!
chinese: 我去把我自己的人頭送給她

english: Speak, ye Nibelungen, will you buy your lives with Hagen Tronje's head? !
chinese: 尼伯龍根的人們，你們願意用哈根·特洛涅的人頭換自己的一條命嗎？

english: Loyalty, unbroken by iron, also will not melt in fire, Hagen Tronje!
chinese: 忠誠還在，人心還在！ 大火面前，沒人動搖，哈根·特洛涅！

english: Volker prepares his fiddle for one final song!
chinese: 福爾克正在準備演奏最終篇章呢！

english: I call it a shame and a disgrace,
chinese: 這真是恥辱至極！

english: Lady Kriemhild, that you let these heroes whom you could not defeat in battle be annihilated in fiery distress!
chinese: 克裏米爾特夫人 你沒法用手裏的武器戰勝對手！ 卻用這樣下三濫的手段把他們全部燒死了！

english: Do you hear? Lord Volker is singing!
chinese: 有沒有聽見福爾克爵士正在裏面唱歌？

english: O, that we were on the cool, green Rhine!
chinese: 我們現在倍感清涼，綠色的萊茵河啊！

english: You are no human being, Lady Kriemhild -!
chinese: 克裏米爾特夫人，你簡直不是人！

english: I died when Siegfried died...
chinese: 當齊格弗裏德死的時候，我也死了...

english: An end -!
chinese: 該結束了！

english: One vassal still lives, Lord Attila!
chinese: 匈奴王，還有一名封臣沒死！

english: I cannot go home to my dead Siegfried before having atoned for every wrong...
chinese: 在一切的不公正得以糾正之前 我還無法還鄉去面對齊格弗裏德

english: Here is the sword, Lord Hagen. Where is the Treasure?
chinese: 這兒就是劍，哈根大人，那些財寶在哪裏？

english: I swore never to betray the location of the Treasure so long as one of my kings still lives!
chinese: 我發過誓，只要我的王還活著 我就永不洩露那個藏寶地點

english: Now, Kriemhild, no-one knows anything of the Treasure other than God and myself!
chinese: 現在，克裏米爾特，除了上帝還有我自己 再也沒人知道藏寶地址了

english: And God is no more discreet than I!
chinese: 而上帝也不會告訴你更多的

english: Now, Earth, drink your fill!
chinese: 盡情地喝個夠吧，大地！

english: Deliver her home to Siegfried, her dead husband!
chinese: 把她送回到她死去的丈夫齊格弗裏德的身邊！

english: She belonged to no other man!
chinese: 她不該屬於別的任何男人！

english: Here does the myth have an end.
chinese: 故事就這麼講完了

english: Reconstruction and synchronisation:
chinese: 本片內容以及字幕僅供學習交流，嚴禁用於商業途徑 中文字幕校譯： yourtear@TLF

english: Die Nibelungen
chinese: 【尼伯龍根】

english: Siegfried
chinese: 齊格弗裏德

english: Canto I
chinese: 第1節

english: How Siegfried slayed the dragon
chinese: 【齊格弗裏德打倒巨龍】

english: Thus spoke Mime, the artful blacksmith: "Siegfried, son of King Siegmund, ride home to Xanten.
chinese: 老工匠米梅說回故鄉去吧! 齊格蒙德王的兒子齊格弗裏德! 我已經沒什麼能教你了

english: Have you never before heard of the king's castle at Worms on the Rhine and the kings of Burgundy who reign there?
chinese: 難道你從沒聽說過在萊因河畔 布盧郡王們統治著的渥努姆斯城嗎？

english: I shall go there towing Kriemhild!
chinese: 我一定要去贏得克裏米爾特！

english: Show me the way to Worms or you will lose your life!
chinese: 告訴我怎麼去渥努姆斯 要不然別怪我不客氣！

english: Farewell, Siegfried, son of king Siegmund. You will never get to Worms!
chinese: 再見了齊格弗裏德，齊格蒙德王之子 你是永遠到不了渥努姆斯的！

english: Young Siegfried understood the bird's song:
chinese: 這時，年輕人齊格弗裏德聽明白了鳥兒的歌：

english: If the dragon slayer would bathe in the dragon's blood, his body would become invincible, forever safe against sword and spear!
chinese: 當殺死龍的那個人，用龍血沐浴之後... ...那他就會變成金剛不壞之身！

english: Here ends the first Canto
chinese: 第1節結束

english: Canto II
chinese: 第2節

english: Now Volker, the bard, sang of Siegfried in front of Kriemhild, and how Siegfried came to Worms.
chinese: 【弗路卡向克裏米爾特謳歌齊格弗裏德】 【齊格弗裏德千辛萬苦趕往渥努姆斯】

english: The violin sounded and Volker sang:
chinese: 弗路卡撥弦唱道：

english: The dragon slayer, the son of Siegmund entered the realm of the Nibelungen.
chinese: 屠龍勇士齊格蒙德之子進入了尼伯龍根的王國

english: He won the fight against the dragon. There is no one on earth like him.
chinese: 他百戰百勝，世上無人能敵

english: Thus spoke Alberich, the Nibelung: Spare my life and I will give you the wonder cap.
chinese: 尼伯龍根族的阿路貝尼說 勇者啊，我把隱身頭巾送給你

english: Whoever wears it becomes unseen or may take whatever form he chooses!
chinese: 它可隱藏一切，請你饒過我吧

english: Spare my life, O hero, and I will make you the richest king on earth!
chinese: 繞過我吧！ 勇士！ 我會讓你成為世上最富有的王！

english: The crown of the King of the Northland, the ruler of the Ice giants is being wrought here by the Nibelungen.
chinese: 尼伯龍根族給北方的支配者冰之巨人鍛造王冠

english: No sword on earth compares with Balmung. The Nibelungen forged it in fire of blood.
chinese: 尼伯龍根族在血的火焰中 做出了絕世好劍巴爾蒙格

english: All is lost. Cursed be the heritage of the heir! Return with me to stone all ye whom from stone were wrought.
chinese: 遺產的繼承者將受到詛咒 當失去遺產後就會變成石頭

english: Siegfried became the dragon slayer The lord of the Nibelungen Treasure.
chinese: 齊格弗裏德成為屠龍者後

english: Twelve kingdoms subdued the powerful. Twelve kings became his vassals.
chinese: 又成為尼伯龍根財寶的主人 十二國的國王都要臣服於他

english: Kriemhild, the daughter of Ute: "Volker, take this cloak, as reward for your song!
chinese: 克裏米爾特說: 弗路卡! 把我親手縫製的外套拿去吧!

english: I embroidered it myself.
chinese: 作為給你的歌聲的謝禮!

english: Siegfried, son of King Sigmund, is outside the castle door with twelve of his knights, and asks for an audience with King Gunther.
chinese: 齊格蒙德之子齊格弗裏德 和12個勇者一起來到城門 求見龔特爾王

english: Thus spake Hagen Tronje:
chinese: 哈根·特洛涅說:

english: King Gunther, let the dragon slayer go his ways, don't welcome him here!
chinese: 讓屠龍者繞道吧，我的王！ 不要讓他進來！

english: No one shall say that at Worms one does not know the way kings greet each other!
chinese: 在渥努姆斯怎麼能不顧待客之道

english: Siegfried, son of King Siegmund, has my welcome!
chinese: 齊格蒙德之子齊格弗裏德是來拜訪我的！ 我應該歡迎他！

english: I dreamt last night an awful dream...
chinese: 我昨晚作了個不祥的夢

english: And now this dream comes to my mind!
chinese: 我現在想起來這夢境了

english: I come, King Gunther, to ask for your sister Kriemhild's hand.
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，我是來向 你的妹妹克裏米爾特求婚的

english: King Gunther, too, has marriage plans. He has set his heart on a bold and mighty maiden.
chinese: 龔特爾殿下也自己希望得到婚姻 他喜歡上了一個勇敢倔強的烈女

english: Her name is Brunhild and she is Queen of Iceland.
chinese: 她的名字叫做布侖希爾德女王

english: Ringed by fire, her invincible castle towers in the Northland.
chinese: 她的城池火耀北境，無敵於世

english: Why must you speak of Brunhild?
chinese: 你提我跟布侖希爾德的事幹嘛！

english: You know she has set dangerous conditions: Thrice must the suitor best her in feats of strength or die!
chinese: 你不知道只有能夠戰勝她的最強勇士 才能贏得她嗎？

english: Siegfried, the unique hero, has come to Worms at an opportune moment.
chinese: 無敵勇士齊格弗裏德來得正好啊

english: He may help us win Brunhild for you!
chinese: 他應該能幫助殿下得到布侖希爾德的

english: Twelve kings have I for vassals. But vassal am I to no man, now and ever!
chinese: 我有十二個王者為臣 我過去和將來都不會俯首於人

english: Prepare for the quest to get your bride, King Gunther. It is Siegfried the mighty hero who will win Brunhild for you.
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，準備迎接新娘吧 勇士齊格弗裏德會為殿下得到布侖希爾德！

english: Here ends the second Canto.
chinese: 第2節結束

english: Canto III:
chinese: 第3節

english: How Siegfried won Brunhild for Gunther
chinese: 【齊格弗裏德如何為龔特爾得到布侖希爾德】

english: The dragon ship is carrying foreign heroes to your shores!
chinese: 異國的勇士們乘著龍頭大船到達你的海岸了！

english: The foreigners are nearing the flaming sea.
chinese: 異國人接近火焰之海了

english: If he be strong enough and favored by the gods, the flames will consume themselves and die.
chinese: 當強者來臨，火焰是擋不住他們的

english: My maidens, help me put on my armor, this will be a fight I've never fought before!
chinese: 帶我的裝備來，姑娘們 這是前所未有的戰鬥

english: Welcome, hero, for the fight for life or death!
chinese: 歡迎來到這場生死搏鬥，勇士

english: Neither life nor death do I desire from you, Brunhild.
chinese: 我過來不是要你死我活，布侖希爾德！

english: It is King Gunther who woos you!
chinese: 龔特爾想要娶你！

english: Before it is evening, King Gunther, your smothered weapons will adorn my hall.
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，不用等到夜晚 你折斷的武器就將成為我大廳的裝飾！

english: Give me leave, King Gunther, to make ready your ship for Bronhild, your royal bride.
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，容我告假，去跟船隊說：

english: We should set sail for home before sundown!
chinese: 不用等到夜晚，你的新娘布侖希爾德 就會和你一起回國

english: Let the triple battle begin, King Gunther!
chinese: 我們比試三個回合，龔特爾殿下

english: You have to defeat me three times, king: with the stone, the spring, and the spear.
chinese: 你要在投石，跳遠，標槍三項都勝過我

english: Fear not, king! Make you the motions and my strength will win each contest. I'll throw the stone for you and carry you in the jump.
chinese: 拿出勇氣 殿下 我來幫你投石 我會抱著你跳遠

english: Here ends the third Canto
chinese: 第3節結束

english: Canto IV
chinese: 第4節

english: How Brunhild enters Worms and how the kings celebrated their wedding.
chinese: 【布侖希爾德來到渥努姆斯！ 國王娶親！

english: Start the prepartions for marriage! The king's ship is arriving!
chinese: 快準備婚禮 國王的船接近了!

english: We have reached our destination, my queen!
chinese: 我們抵達了，我的王后！

english: Are you really the man who defeated me threefold?
chinese: 你是那個擊敗了我三次的人嗎？

english: I am your captive, but I shall never be your wife!
chinese: 我是你的囚犯，可我絕不會做你的妻子！

english: Keep your word, King Gunther, as I have kept mine!
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，請實現你和我的約定

english: If Kriemhild gives her consent, hero, we shall celebrate a double wedding here today.
chinese: 克裏米爾特答應的話 今天就舉行我們各自的婚禮

english: Since when is it customary among Burgundians to give the King's daughter in marriage to a vassal?
chinese: 國王把妹妹賜給下臣，這算什麼？

english: Siegfried is no vassal. I love him as though he were my brother. We shall become blood brothers today!
chinese: 齊格弗裏德不是我的下臣 今天起他是我的結盟兄弟

english: Blood is mingling with red blood, the drops fuse inseparably.
chinese: 紅色的鮮血將融為一體

english: Whoever forsakes loyalty to the bloodbrother will perish at the wayside, all honor is lost!
chinese: 打破結拜兄弟忠誠的人 將卑微地死於路旁

english: Brunhild has been defeated, not cowed.
chinese: 布侖希爾德雖然輸了，但沒有屈服

english: Shall the king of Burgundy be scorned by an obstinate woman?
chinese: 布盧郡王會因為這個強勢妻子而受人嘲笑嗎？

english: Damned be the deed half done! Will you forsake your friend who gave you his own sister?
chinese: 半途而廢的事不該讚賞 對與獻出自己妹妹給你的朋友 你會見死不救嗎？

english: The magic cap will change you into what you wish. Take Gunther's form and break Brunhild's iron will.
chinese: 隱身頭巾能按你的想法改變相貌 你快變成我，打消布侖希爾德的反抗心

english: Here ends the fourth Canto
chinese: 第4節結束

english: Canto V
chinese: 第5節

english: How, after half a year, Siegfried's gift to his bride, the Nibelungen Treasure, arrives in Worms and how the two queens quarrel with each other.
chinese: 【6個月後，齊格弗裏德的贈禮 尼伯龍根的財寶到達渥努姆斯】 【兩個王后發生爭鬥】

english: O king, Burgundy's glory is waning, we need the Nibelungen treasure.
chinese: 布盧郡的榮光正在褪色 我們需要尼伯龍根的財寶

english: It would be folly to reject what Siegfried offers you as a brother and Kriemhild is worth more than all the gold in the world!
chinese: 齊格弗裏德是你的兄弟 不會拒絕你的要求的 而且克裏米爾特比全世界的黃金更有價值

english: See what I found!
chinese: 看，我發現了這個！

english: Put away the armlet, Kriemhild, it guards an ugly secret.
chinese: 把那個手鐲脫下！

english: The Mistress of the Nibelungen Treasure has no need for it!
chinese: 克裏米爾特 尼伯龍根財寶的主人不需要這 有著邪惡秘密的東西

english: Listen, Kriemhild, at how I won the armlet - and keep silent!
chinese: 告訴你，我得到那個手鐲的事 但不要告訴別人

english: The Nibelungen treasure has arrived!
chinese: 尼伯龍根的財寶運到了！

english: How long, King Gunther, will Siegfried and Kriemhild tarry at the court of Burgundy?
chinese: 龔特爾殿下,齊格弗裏德和克裏米爾特還要留在渥努姆斯多久？

english: They stay for the sake of my mother.
chinese: 為了我的母親，他們還會留一陣子！

english: Would you, Brunhild, be willing to take up the daughter's place for Queen Ute?
chinese: 布侖希爾德，你覺得自己能替代我妹妹的位置嗎？

english: Your brother's honor is entwined with this armlet. It never should be seen again by human eyes!
chinese: 這手鐲關係到你兄長的名譽 千萬不要再讓別人看到它了

english: It seems to me high time, King Gunther, that you send Siegfried back home to Xanten!
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，我覺得是時候讓齊格弗裏德 回他自己的家鄉去了

english: Never! He shall leave of his own freewill!
chinese: 不行，他自己有決定的自由！

english: I am going to attend mass, my daughter.
chinese: 我去參加彌撒了，乖女兒...

english: Follow me soon!
chinese: 你等會兒過來吧！

english: I'll go to the cathedral in the regalia of the queen of Burgundy!
chinese: 我想要穿上皇后的正式服裝去教堂！

english: The wife of a vassal may not precede the Queen of Burgundy!
chinese: 臣子的妻子怎麼能先於 布侖希爾德王后進入大教堂！

english: How did you dare refer to Siegfried, my husband?
chinese: 你稱我丈夫齊格弗裏德為什麼？

english: Siegfried introduced himself to me as Gunther's vassal and servant. He did servant's work for my husband!
chinese: 齊格弗裏德是龔特爾的臣子 他只是我丈夫一個護衛 他的妻子理應順從於我！

english: You, whom he disdained. You, whom he gave away. You dare to belittle Siegfried?
chinese: 你對他來說不值一提 你是他送給別人的戰利品 竟然還敢藐視他？

english: Make way for the Queen of Burgundy, vassal woman!
chinese: 快給布盧郡王后讓路，狗奴才！

english: You recognize this armlet, you queen of Burgundy?
chinese: 布盧郡王后，認得這個手鐲嗎？

english: How came that armlet into your hand?
chinese: 這個手鐲為什麼會在你手上？

english: The carrier of the magic helmet who, disguised as Gunther, defeated you three times - Siegfried, my husband gave it to me!
chinese: 隱身披的主人裝成龔特爾王擊敗了你三次 這是我的丈夫齊格弗裏德送給我的

english: King! Speaks your sister the truth?
chinese: 殿下，這是真的嗎？

english: Kill Siegfried!
chinese: 殺了齊格弗裏德！

english: Your babbling, hero, was worse than murder!
chinese: 三人成虎，惡於殺人！

english: Siegfried is safe from your wrath. None can slay the dragon slayer!
chinese: 屠龍勇士齊格弗裏德是不死之身 他不會被你的復仇心所傷的！

english: Save in one spot, where the linden leaf clung, is he vulnerable as other men!
chinese: 可以把劍往當年樹葉遮蓋的地方插下去！

english: King Gunther, let me deal with the dragon slayer!
chinese: 龔特爾王，屠龍者就交給我解決吧！

english: We pledged blood brotherhood. How can I be party to his death?
chinese: 我們是歃血為盟的兄弟 難道要因為他的忠誠而殺他？

english: The one who took the armlet from me made me his wife, took my maidenhood from me!
chinese: 把我的手鐲搶走的人，應該娶我為妻 是他奪走了我的貞潔！

english: Tronje, announce to the people of Burgundy that I invite everybody to a royal hunt to kill a mad dog and a ravening.
chinese: 告訴全布盧郡的人，我要請他們去打獵 這是狩獵的好季節啊，有一頭游離的狼等著我們去捕殺

english: Here ends the fifth Canto.
chinese: 第5節結束

english: Canto VI
chinese: 第6節

english: How Gunther betrayed Siegfried.
chinese: 【龔特爾對齊格弗裏德背信棄義】

english: Can you keep a secret Kriemhild?
chinese: 克裏米爾特，難道你能保持沉默嗎？

english: I once broke the oath to be silent and never will do so again!
chinese: 我已經打破了一次誓言，現在再也不能那樣了

english: Well then, the upcoming hunt might easily turn into a chase for men.
chinese: 狩鹿活動很容易會變成對人的殺戮

english: A secret message warns me of war against Burgundy!
chinese: 我已得到準備戰鬥的秘令 布盧郡的戰火已經很難避免了

english: Good for you, Kriemhild, that your husband is the dragon slayer, the invincible!
chinese: 放心吧，克裏米爾特 你的丈夫是屠龍者，是不死身！

english: Who warrants me that in the heat of battle not a chance blade should pierce where the lime leaf fell?
chinese: 那誰又能擔保，萬一在戰鬥時 碰巧被敵人攻擊到 當時樹葉遮蓋的地方呢？

english: If you want me to protect him, I have to know the exact spot where the invicible could be hurt!
chinese: 如果需要我來保護他 那我就一定要知道那個弱點在哪裏！

english: You are good counsel, you truest of true.
chinese: 你的忠誠不容我懷疑！

english: I shall mark the spot with a little cross myself!
chinese: 我會為你在那個位置做上十字記號的

english: I come to take leave, Brunhild. We are starting for the hunt in the Odenwald forest.
chinese: 我是來道別的，布侖希爾德 我們要去森林狩獵了

english: Mind my vow, King Gunther, I shall not eat nor drink until my disgrace has been vindicated!
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，不要忘記我們的約定 在報仇前，我會一直不吃不喝

english: O my dear lord, don't leave me. I dreamt last night a furious boar tore you to pieces!
chinese: 啊，我的夫君，請不要離開我 我昨晚夢見，你被一隻兇暴的豬撕裂

english: O my dear lord, don't leave me. I dreamt further that two mountains collapsed and buried you!
chinese: 啊，我的夫君，請不要離開我 我昨晚還夢見，兩座大山向你坍塌

english: Today Gunther and I will reconcile. Who else is my enemy?
chinese: 今天我要和龔特爾和解 我就沒有別的敵人了

english: Mother, I feel as if blood is draining from my heart!
chinese: 母親，我心如滴血啊！

english: The hunt in the Odenwald forest lasted from morning until sundown.
chinese: 在森林的狩獵從清晨一直持續到日落

english: A handful of red gold for a cooling draught of white wine!
chinese: 我真想用滿滿一捧黃金去換口酒喝呀！

english: A wheel broke from the wagon loaded with wine. But I know of a cool brook nearby!
chinese: 運酒的車，車輪壞了 不過我知道有個地方有冰涼的泉水

english: I always heard of you as the fastest runner of all heroes, let's run, you and I, for the first draught!
chinese: 我之前聽他們讚美你身手矯健 本來是想跟你比比，誰能先喝到水的

english: Gunther, my brother, let's be friends again!
chinese: 兄長，我們和好吧

english: When you are back from the spring!
chinese: 等你從泉水那邊回來再說吧

english: Grim Hagen spoke:
chinese: 殘忍的哈根宣佈：

english: The hunt is over!"
chinese: 狩獵結束了！

english: Here ends the sixth Canto.
chinese: 第6節結束

english: Canto VII
chinese: 第7節

english: How Kriemhild swears revenge to Hagen Tronje
chinese: 【克裏米爾特向哈根復仇】

english: You may break your fast, Brumhild, Siegfried is dead.
chinese: 布侖希爾德，我實現諾言了 齊格弗裏德死了

english: Hail to you King Gunther! For the sake of a woman's lie, you have slain your most loyal friend!
chinese: 祝福你，龔特爾王，因為女人的謊言 你殺死了自己最忠實的朋友

english: I call to you for justice, King Gunther! Hagen Tronje has slain my husband!
chinese: 龔特爾殿下，請你裁決哈根 是他殺了我的丈夫

english: Loyalty for loyalty, Kriemhild.
chinese: 用忠誠換取忠誠，克裏米爾特！

english: His deed is ours.
chinese: 他做的就是我們做的！

english: His fate is ours.
chinese: 他的自由就是我們的自由！

english: Our breast is his shield.
chinese: 我們的胸膛就是他的盾牌！

english: You might try to hide among my clan, behind the altars of God, or at the end of the world
chinese: 無論你躲在我們一族的背後 還是躲到世界盡頭的眾神的神壇

english: - You cannot escape my vengeance, Hagen Tronje!
chinese: 我都會報仇的，哈根·特洛涅

english: Announce to King Gunther, my brother, the Queen of Burgundy is dead!
chinese: 告訴我哥龔特爾王 布盧郡的女王已死！

english: Thus ends the tale of Siegfried.
chinese: 齊格弗裏德的故事到這裏就結束了

english: Part one.
chinese: 科托谢夫

english: "MEN AND MAGGOTS."
chinese: 第一章 "人与虫"

english: The spirit of revolution soared over the Russian land.
chinese: 革命之火席卷俄罗斯大地

english: A tremendous, mysterious process was taking place in countless hearts.
chinese: 无数颗心中暗潮涌动，群情激昂

english: The individual personality, having hardly had time to become conscious of itself... dissolved in the mass, and the mass itself became dissolved in the revolutionary élan.
chinese: 长期以来被自身所忽视的个体人格... 溶入到社会中，而社会本身又溶入到 革命的洪流之中

english: Sailors Matyushenko and Vakulinchuk.
chinese: 水手马图申科和瓦库林楚克

english: We, the sailors of Potemkin, must support the workers, our brothers... and stand among the front lines of the revolution!
chinese: 我们，波坦金号的水手 必须支持我们的工人兄弟... 站到革命的最前线！

english: Heavy and gloomy is the sleep of the off duty.
chinese: 休息的水手们睡得死气沉沉

english: Attentive, but clumsy.
chinese: 专心，但是笨拙

english: He vents his anger on a young man.
chinese: 他把怒火发泄到一个年轻人身上

english: Hurtful...
chinese: 痛苦...

english: Vakulinchuk
chinese: 瓦库林楚克

english: Comrades!
chinese: 同志们！

english: The time has come when we too must speak out.
chinese: 也到了我们该大声疾呼的时候了

english: Why wait?
chinese: 还等什么？

english: All of Russia has risen!
chinese: 整个俄罗斯都起义了！

english: Are we to be the last?
chinese: 我们要当缩头乌龟吗？

english: We've had enough rotten meat!
chinese: 我们再也不吃腐肉了！

english: Even a dog wouldn't eat this!
chinese: 这东西就连狗都不吃！

english: The ship doctor Smirnov.
chinese: 船医斯莫诺夫

english: It could crawl overboard on its own!
chinese: 这块肉都能自个儿爬到海里去了！ (形容虫多)

english: These aren't worms.
chinese: 这些不是虫

english: They are dead fly larvae. You can wash them off with brine!
chinese: 只是苍蝇的幼仔，用盐水洗掉就行了！

english: Russian prisoners in Japan are fed better than we are!
chinese: 俄罗斯关在日本的战犯吃得都比我们好！

english: It's good meat. End of discussion!
chinese: 这是好肉，别再哆嗦了！

english: Senior Officer Giliarovsky
chinese: 高级军官基里亚罗夫斯基

english: Impotent rage was overflowing.
chinese: 无奈的愤怒在漫延

english: The ship's store.
chinese: 船上的贮藏室

english: The sailors refused to eat the borscht.
chinese: 水手们拒绝喝罗宋汤

english: GIVE US THIS DAY OUR DAILY BREAD
chinese: 把今天的面包给我们

english: Part two. "DRAMA ON THE DECK."
chinese: 第二章 "甲板风云"

english: Commander Golikov
chinese: 指挥官戈里科夫

english: Whoever is satisfied with the borscht take two steps forward!
chinese: 对罗宋汤感到满意的人... 向前两步走！

english: The petty officers.
chinese: 海军士官们

english: You're free to go!
chinese: 你们可以走了！

english: I'll hang the rest on the yard!
chinese: 我将在船舷上吊死其他人！

english: Call the guards!
chinese: 叫警卫！

english: Matyushenko, under the guise of breaking ranks, calls the sailors to the gun turret.
chinese: 马图申科趁着一片混乱 将水手们召集到炮台旁

english: To the turret...
chinese: 去炮台...

english: To the turret!
chinese: 去炮台！

english: Guys! ...
chinese: 兄弟们！

english: It's time.
chinese: 是时候了

english: Most of them gathered by the turret.
chinese: 他们中的大多数人聚集到炮台旁

english: Don't move!
chinese: 不许动！

english: They try to sneak through the admiral's hatch.
chinese: 他们试图进入上将的指挥舱

english: Back, scoundrels!
chinese: 退后，无赖！

english: That way is not for you!
chinese: 这条通道不是给你们用的！

english: I'll shoot you all like dogs!
chinese: 我要把你们全都宰了！

english: Cover them with canvas!
chinese: 拿帆布把他们盖上！

english: Got it!
chinese: 明白！

english: Cover them!
chinese: 把他们盖上！

english: Attention!
chinese: 立正！

english: Dear Lord!
chinese: 上帝啊！

english: Make the disobedient see reason!
chinese: 快让这群叛乱分子醒悟吧！

english: Fire right into the canvas!
chinese: 朝帆布上开火！

english: Vakulinchuk decides.
chinese: 瓦库林楚克决定了

english: BROTHERS!
chinese: 兄弟们！

english: Who are you shooting at?
chinese: 你们在向谁开枪？

english: The rifles quavered.
chinese: 步枪走火了

english: Shoot!
chinese: 发射！

english: Everyone shoot!
chinese: 所有人发射！

english: Shoot, scum!
chinese: 射啊，混蛋！

english: To the rifles, brothers!
chinese: 去抢步枪，兄弟们！

english: Smash the dragons!
chinese: 杀了这些混蛋！

english: Smash 'em!
chinese: 杀了他们！

english: Smash 'em all!
chinese: 杀了他们所有人！

english: Have fear of God!
chinese: 对上帝心存敬畏！

english: Beat it, sorcerer!
chinese: 滚开，巫师！

english: To the bottom to feed the worms!
chinese: 滚到底层去喂虫子！

english: Brothers!
chinese: 兄弟们！

english: We've won!
chinese: 我们胜利了！

english: The bleeding Vakulinchuk flees from the furious Giliarovsky.
chinese: 头破血流的瓦库林楚克 从残暴的基里亚罗夫斯基手下逃脱

english: Vakulinchuk's overboard!
chinese: 瓦库林楚克落海了！

english: Save Vakulinchuk!
chinese: 快救瓦库林楚克！

english: And he who was first to sound the cry of rebellion was first to fall at the executioner's hand.
chinese: 第一个挑动叛乱的人最先被处决

english: To the shore.
chinese: 朝岸边前进

english: Odessa.
chinese: 奥德萨(苏联港口)

english: A tent on the new pier in Odessa is the final resting place for Vakulinchuk.
chinese: 奥德萨新码头上的一座帐篷是 瓦库林楚克最后的安息处

english: FOR A SPOONFUL OF BORSCHT
chinese: 为了一勺罗宋汤

english: Part three. "THE DEAD MAN CALLS OUT."
chinese: 第三 章 "死者的呼喊"

english: Mist lingered on from the night...
chinese: 夜晚的大雾苟延残喘到现在...

english: Rumours came from the pier.
chinese: 来自码头的谣言

english: Together with the sun, the news hit the city.
chinese: 叛变的消息和清晨的第一缕阳光 一道照进了城市

english: The battleship raided rebellion shore...
A killed sailor...
chinese: 一名水手被杀...

english: We'll remember.
chinese: 我们会记住的

english: For a spoonful of borscht.
chinese: 为了一勺罗宋汤

english: "Citizens of Odessa!
chinese: 奥德萨的市民们！

english: Lying before you is the body of the brutally killed sailor Grigory Vakulinchuk... killed by a senior officer of the squadron battleship Prince Tavrichesky.
chinese: 躺在大家面前的是被残 忍杀害的水手格里高力 . 瓦库林楚克的遗体 杀害他的是"塔夫里切斯基 王子号"战舰的高级军官

english: Let's take revenge on the bloodthirsty vampires!
chinese: 让我们向那群凶残的吸血鬼复仇！

english: Death to the oppressors!
chinese: 消灭压迫者！

english: Signed: Crew of the squadron battleship Prince Tavrichesky."
chinese: 签名："塔夫里切斯基王子号"战舰全体船员

english: Eternal memory to the fallen fighters!
chinese: 英勇牺牲的战士永垂不朽！

english: All for one.
chinese: 人人为我

english: One for all.
chinese: 我... 为人人

english: Down with the executioners!
chinese: 打倒刽子手！

english: Down with tyranny!
chinese: 打倒专制！

english: Mothers and brothers!
chinese: 母亲们，兄弟们！

english: Let there not be differences or hostility among us!
chinese: 让我们化解分歧与敌意团结起来！

english: Smash the Jews!
chinese: 消灭犹太人！

english: Shoulder to shoulder.
chinese: 并肩战斗

english: The land is ours.
chinese: 国家属于我们

english: Tomorrow is ours.
chinese: 明天属于我们

english: A delegate from shore.
chinese: 岸上来的代表

english: The enemy must be dealt a decisive blow!
chinese: 敌人必将遭到毁灭性的打击！

english: Together with the rebelling workers from all of Russia
chinese: 和全俄罗斯的造反工人们一起

english: WE WILL WIN!
chinese: 我们必将胜利！

english: The shore watched Potemkin tensely and attentively.
chinese: 岸上的群众密切关注着波坦金号

english: Part four. "THE ODESSA STAIRCASE."
chinese: 第四章 "奥德萨阶梯"

english: In those memorable days, the city lived together with the rebellious battleship.
chinese: 在那些值得纪念的日子里 城市与起义的战舰同舟共济

english: Like a white-winged flock, boats flew to the battleship.
chinese: 无数只小船如同羽翼纯白的鸟群般涌向战舰

english: Let's go!
chinese: 走啊！

english: Let's convince them!
chinese: 我们去说服他们！

english: Listen!
chinese: 听着！

english: Don't shoot!
chinese: 别开枪！

english: My boy is badly hurt.
chinese: 我的孩子受了重伤

english: COSSACKS!
chinese: 哥萨克人！

english: And then the brutality of the military authorities in Odessa was answered with the battleship's shells.
chinese: 战舰以炮火回应奥德萨军方的暴行

english: The target - the Odessa theater.
chinese: 目标 -奥德萨剧院

english: The generals' headquarters.
chinese: 将军的指挥部

english: Part five. "RENDEZVOUS WITH THE SQUADRON."
chinese: 第五章 "胜利大会师"

english: Turbulent meetings went on until evening.
chinese: 争吵的会议持续到傍晚

english: The people of Odessa are waiting for the liberators!
chinese: 奥德萨人民在等待解放者！

english: Land the troops and the army will join you.
chinese: 让部队靠岸，军队会加入你们的

english: Landing is not possible. The admiral's squadron is coming our way.
chinese: 靠岸是不可能的 上将的舰队正朝我们驶来

english: With one heart, they decided to face the squadron.
chinese: 万众一心，他们决定给舰队以迎头痛击

english: Night came, full of anxiety.
chinese: 夜幕降临，满怀焦虑

english: The squadron was sneaking up in the darkness.
chinese: 舰队在黑暗中悄悄逼近

english: Soon after its premiere, the film Metropolis was severely truncated and alterations were made. From that time onward, more than a quarter of the film was assumed to have been lost. Then, in 2008, a virtually complete version of the film was discovered in Buenos Aires.

english: A considerable amount of the film reconstruction was able to be completed and the correct sequence of its editing established by means of this Argentinian material. Spanish intertitles have been translated into German with the aid of the censor-cards. In order to display in their correct position on the image the cropped elements taken from the 16mm negative, the missing portion of the frame has been marked by black.
chinese: 电影的修复耗费了大量的工作 借助在阿根廷发现的电影素材 原始电影剪辑序列得以修复完成 片中的植入字幕通过审查卡被重新读写 并由阿根廷版本中的西班牙语重新转译为德语 为了使这16毫米底片上缺失的元素 在画面上呈现原始面貌 每一帧上丢失的部分由黑色标出

english: The intertitles appear with their original graphic treatment. english: There were two more copies of those damnable plans, Herr Fredersen in the pockets of two men who met with an accident today at the M-Machine...
chinese: 弗莱德森先生 我们又找到了 这该死的平面图的两份复印件 M型机器今天发生了一起事故 我们就是从两位受伤工人的口袋中发现的

english: How is it, Josaphat, that these plans were brought to me by Grot, rather than by you?
chinese: 约萨法特 这事你怎么看 为什么是格罗特而不是你来向我汇报

english: Apply to the G-Bank for your remaining wages...
chinese: 去银行领取你剩下的工资

english: Father, do you know what it means to be dismissed by you? ― It means:
chinese: 父亲 您知道被您解雇意味着什么吗 它意味着遣送地底 父亲 地底 是去地下城

english: Do you know what it means to be dismissed like that by Joh Fredersen?
chinese: 你知道被乔·弗莱德森这样 解雇意味着什么吗

english: Would you like to come with me, Josaphat?
chinese: 你愿意追随我吗 约萨法特

english: Go home, Josaphat, and wait for me... I still have a long way to go tonight...
chinese: 回家去等我 约萨法特 今晚我还有很长的路要走

english: Into the Depths, ― to my brothers...
chinese: 我要去地底 到我的兄弟那儿去

english: From today on I wish to be kept precisely informed of my son's every move...
chinese: 从今天起我希望每时每刻得到 我儿子每一步行动的准确汇报

english: Brother the Machine!
chinese: 兄弟 机器 必须有人守着机器 会有人守着机器的

english: There will be someone at the machine...
chinese: 我来 会有人守着机器的

english: Listen to me... I want to trade my life with you...
chinese: 听我说 我想和你交换我的生活

english: Josaphat. 99th Block. House 7, 7th Floor.
chinese: 约萨法特 99号街区7栋7楼

english: Wait for me ― both of you...
chinese: 你们两位 都等着我

english: Josaphat.
chinese: 约萨法特 99号街区7栋7楼

english: House 7, 7th Floor.
chinese: 约萨法特 99号街区7栋7楼

english: In the middle of Metropolis, there stands a strange house that the centuries had overlooked.
chinese: 在大都会中央城区 有一座被世世代代所遗忘的鬼屋

english: The man who dwelled within was Rotwang, the inventor.
chinese: 发明家洛宏就住在这里

english: Hel Born to bring me happiness and a benediction to all mankind. Lost to Joh Fredersen.
chinese: 你的生为我带来欢乐 为全人类带来祝福 却失身于乔·弗莱德森 在生下其子弗雷德后因难产而死 海尔

english: A mind like yours, Rotwang, should be able to forget...
chinese: 洛宏 像你这样聪明的人 应该学会去忘记

english: Only one time in life did I forget something: that Hel was a woman ― and you a man...
chinese: 一生中我只忘记过一个事实 那就是 海尔是一个女人 而你是一个男人

english: Let the dead lie, Rotwang... She's dead for you as she is for me...
chinese: 让死者安息吧 洛宏 我们都已经失去了她

english: For me she isn't dead, Joh Fredersen ― for me she lives — !
chinese: 她没有死 乔·弗莱德森 对我来说她还活着

english: Do you think the loss of a hand is too high a price for recreating Hel ― ? !
chinese: 我为了重新创造海尔而失去了这只手 你觉得不值吗

english: Do you wish to see her ― ? !
chinese: 你想见见她吗

english: Now, Joh Fredersen ― ? ! Isn't it worth losing a hand to have created the man of the future ― the Machine-Man — ?
chinese: 就现在 乔·弗莱德森 我虽然失去了一只手 但创造了未来的人类—机器人 这难道不值吗

english: 24 more hours of work ― and no man, Joh Fredersen, will be able to differentiate the Machine-Man from a mortal ― !
chinese: 他们可以24小时工作 没有人能够区别机器人和真人

english: The woman is mine, Joh Fredersen! Hel's son was yours!
chinese: 这个女人是我的 乔·弗莱德森 只有海尔的儿子是你的

english: And what brings you my way, Joh Fredersen?
chinese: 你到我这儿来到底有什么事

english: I need your advice ― as usual, when all my experts fail me...
chinese: 和平常一样 当所有的专家都让我失望时 我需要倾听你的意见

english: Can you decipher for me these plans that for months have been getting discovered in the pockets of my workers?
chinese: 你能够为我破译这些平面图吗 数月来我们不断 从工人的口袋中发现这些图纸

english: ...at two... once my shift ends! She has summoned us again...
chinese: 两点整 当我交接班结束 她再次召唤我们

english: Father ― ! Father ― ! Will ten hours never come to an end ― ?
chinese: 父亲啊 父亲 十小时的工作怎么看不到尽头

english: ― it's a blueprint of the two-thousand-year-old catacombs deep below the lowest levels of your Metropolis...
chinese: 这是一张两千年前地下墓穴的蓝图 深藏在比大都会最底层还要深的地下

english: I should like to glean what my workers are doing exactly in those catacombs...
chinese: 我要知道我的工人们 在地下墓穴正在做什么

english: Today I shall tell you the legend of THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE TOWER OF BABEL...
chinese: 今天我要向你们讲述 一个建造巴别塔的传说

english: The Legend of THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE TOWER OF BABEL
chinese: 巴别塔建造的传说

english: Come! Let us build a tower whose zenith shall reach unto the stars!
chinese: 让我们建造一座手可摘星辰的高塔吧

english: And at the tower's zenith we shall write: Great is the world and its Maker! And great is Man!
chinese: 我们要在塔顶上写着 致伟大的世界和她的造物主 致伟大的人类

english: ...but those who had conceived of the Tower of Babel could not build the Tower of Babel. The task was too great. So they paid wages to outside hands...
chinese: 但是那些构想出巴别塔的人们 却无法建造巴别塔 这项工程太巨大了 于是他们向工人支付工钱

english: But the hands that built the Tower of Babel knew nothing of the dream of which the head that had conceived it had been fantasising.
chinese: 但这些用双手建造巴别塔的人们却不了解 这一由头脑构建出来的奇妙的梦想

english: The hymns of praise of one man became the curses of others.
chinese: 巴别塔 赞美的圣歌成为了他人的诅咒

english: The same language was spoken, but these men did not understand one another...
chinese: 即使说着同样的语言 人们却难以互相理解

english: Great is the world and its Maker and great is Man
chinese: 致伟大的世界和她的造物主 致伟大的人类

english: HEAD and HANDS require a Mediator.
chinese: 脑和手需要一个调节者

english: THE MEDIATOR BETWEEN HEAD AND HANDS MUST BE THE HEART!
chinese: 脑和手的调节者一定是心

english: And where is our Mediator, Maria ― ?
chinese: 玛丽娅 我们的调节者在哪儿

english: Wait for him! He will surely come!
chinese: 等待他 他一定会到来

english: We will wait, Maria...! But not for much longer ― !
chinese: 我们会等待 玛丽娅 但我们等不久

english: Oh Mediator, have you finally come...
chinese: 调节者 请你快点到来

english: You summoned me ― here I am!
chinese: 你已经召唤我到你的身边了
